intro: The Sealed Note to Elling is a confidential dispatch penned by the Stormwind fisherman Jorgen. Intended for Elling Trias, the proprietor of Trias' Cheese, it serves as an early link in the discreet investigation surrounding a vanished diplomat.

p: Carrying a sealed note through the bustling avenues of Stormwind might seem mundane, but Jorgen's strict instructions make the stakes clear: deliver the parchment into Elling Trias's hands and keep silent. While Trias outwardly presents himself as a mild-mannered cheese merchant in the Trade District, this clandestine message directs the investigation of the missing diplomat straight to his counter, hinting at networks far deeper than dairy trade.
